name: io.github.aniruddhaadak80/emberwake
description: Emberwake — a 3D beacon game for a real family, where the beacon's geometry is literally the fairness metric. Score who reached a round and who was left out with a deterministic, explainable engine.

environmentVariables.name: EMBERWAKE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a running Emberwake deployment, e.g. https://emberwake.vercel.app

remotes.note: JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST. Send initialize, tools/list and tools/call. Scope follows the Emberwake session cookie.
